title: intentd refuses to start on a socket path over SUN_LEN, and neither the refusal nor the log names the remedy
body:
intentd refuses to start when its socket path exceeds SUN_LEN, and neither the CLI's refusal nor the log names the remedy.

**Seen 2026-09-18** while driving `intent/st/ST0056/gyges-brief.md` in a scratch project under an isolated HOME 106 characters long: `intent daemon start` exited 1 with `intentd was started and is not answering` and a remedy naming the log; the log said `could not bind the daemon's socket listener: path must be shorter than SUN_LEN`. The socket lives at `<XDG_STATE_HOME or ~/.local/state>/intent/run/intentd.sock` (userstate.rs), so any long state directory hits the 104-byte limit macOS puts on a Unix socket path.

**The ask:** the refusal that reaches the person names the cause and the remedy in one line: the socket path, its length, the limit, and that a shorter `XDG_STATE_HOME` moves it. XS.



CLOSED 2026-09-19, by the commit that carries this close, in ic's stacked landing on vc's GO (patch-id 513aa9460, judged green: intentsvcs 1506 passed 0 failed, intent-cli 713 passed 0 failed; the landing run over 0480, 0479 and 0483 together on 2cd1de145: intentsvcs 1510, intent-cli 716, intentd 39, 0 failed). `intent daemon start` asks `socket_path_fits` before it spawns and refuses in one line with the path, its length, the platform limit (read from std's own sockaddr_un construction, not written in the code) and the two XDG directories that move it; intentd's bind site asks the same, so its log says it too. The new a_long_socket_path_is_refused_before_start.rs holds the boundary and drives the refusal under a long XDG_STATE_HOME with nothing spawned; the same scenario on the unfixed pair answered "not answering" with SUN_LEN only in the daemon log.
